about: Motorbikes: a twin by revs, the start, stop, revs, gear clicks and the horn.
notes: v3 (vehicle round). Engine layers are 20 s beds cut to loop, played faster or slower by rpm; slot names match core:vehicle's, so a vehicle of this family is heard by them first and by core:vehicle for the rest.

prompts.text: A motorcycle's twin-cylinder engine idles: a lumpy uneven burble from the exhaust, constant. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/low.want: the motorbike engine at low revs

prompts.text: A motorcycle rides at low revs: a steady deep thrumming exhaust note, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/mid.want: the motorbike engine at middle revs

prompts.text: A motorcycle rides at middle revs: a strong steady snarling exhaust drone, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/high.want: the motorbike engine at full power

prompts.text: A motorcycle rides near its redline: a loud screaming high-pitched howl, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/start.want: the starter and the engine barking into life

prompts.text: A motorcycle is started: the electric starter whirs briefly and the engine barks into life with a blip of the throttle, three separate starts with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A motorcycle's engine is switched off: it cuts out with a last pop from the exhaust, four separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A motorcycle's engine is revved hard while standing: a sharp rising snarl and a crackling fall, four separate revs with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A motorcycle's gearbox clicks into gear with a solid mechanical clunk, six separate shifts with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A motorcycle's small electric horn beeps, short and long beeps, four separate beeps with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
